description: This file defines the 'Middleware' class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, providing various static methods to create middleware functions for handling HTTP requests and responses, such as cookies, error handling, redirects, retries, logging, and request/response mapping.

classes.name: Middleware
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to generate various middleware functions for handling HTTP request/response lifecycle behaviors in GuzzleHttp.

methods.name: cookies
methods.description: Creates middleware that adds cookies to outgoing requests using a CookieJarInterface.

methods.name: httpErrors
methods.description: Creates middleware that throws exceptions for 4xx and 5xx responses when 'http_errors' option is enabled.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Creates middleware that records request and response data in a provided container, supporting arrays and ArrayAccess objects.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Creates middleware that executes optional callbacks before and after sending a request, without altering the response.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates middleware that handles HTTP redirects.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Creates middleware to retry requests based on a provided decider function, with optional delay.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Creates middleware that logs request and response data using a PSR LoggerInterface and a formatter.

methods.name: prepareBody
methods.description: Creates middleware that prepares the request body headers and content.

methods.name: mapRequest
methods.description: Creates middleware that applies a transformation function to requests before they are sent.

methods.name: mapResponse
methods.description: Creates middleware that applies a transformation function to responses after they are received.
